freeze_record.reason: S was competitive with B2 while T and H4 collapsed on development Heat; isolate which measured outcome-channel group changes the S representation without changing data, architecture, objective, or budget

scientific_question.question: Did the development Heat collapse arise from adding the resource/pressure outcome channels, the progress/elapsed/completion channels, or their interaction under the current pooled transition summary?
scientific_question.claim_limit: Only the effect of adding the named learner-visible measured channels to S under this exact representation, training, and search protocol may be discussed; this cannot retroactively establish the failed Phase 3 transition claim, justify pairing, or support final-family access.

structural_controls.same_source_examples: derive S, S-RP, S-PEC, and T from one exact ordered tuple of optimum-imitation DecisionExample records; labels, candidate order, and example order are byte-identical before masking
structural_controls.S_idempotence: applying the S mask to an S tensor changes no byte
structural_controls.mask_partition: within every 12-channel summary block, S-RP intersection S-PEC equals S and S-RP union S-PEC equals the complete T block
structural_controls.retained_byte_identity: every retained current-state, summary, and coverage value equals the corresponding T value byte-for-byte; every excluded value is exactly zero
structural_controls.architecture: all new conditions use the unchanged StateConditionedScorer 54-to-48-to-24-to-1 MLP with exactly 3,841 trainable parameters
structural_controls.reference_policy: reuse locked metrics and exact lineage; do not retrain, rerun, restrict, or retune B2, S, or T

data_and_seed_identity.evidence: reuse the exact 30 Phase 3 evidence payloads and trajectory identities byte-for-byte; regeneration and new evidence probes are forbidden
data_and_seed_identity.examples: optimum-only listwise next-action examples with the exact S/T identities, labels, count, order, and batches
data_and_seed_identity.condition_pairing: each new unit uses the exact S model, probe, search, data-order, environment, family, task, fold, replicate, and candidate-tuple seed identities for its matched unit

fixed_training_and_search.oracle_timing: after the complete fixed candidate batch and independent replay

selection_and_reporting.classification: development-only exploratory diagnostic; not final method selection
selection_and_reporting.condition_selection: independently apply the unchanged Phase 3 rule to each new condition over the complete 12-tuple grid

diagnostic_claim_rules.robust_group_gain: the independently selected condition and its matched-S tuple must each beat locked selected S minimum-family success by strictly more than 0.05, with no development-family success drop greater than 0.05 in either comparison
diagnostic_claim_rules.robust_group_harm: locked selected S must beat both the independently selected condition and its matched-S tuple by strictly more than 0.05
diagnostic_claim_rules.within_tolerance: absolute differences at or below 0.05 are inconclusive for a robust group effect
diagnostic_claim_rules.interaction_diagnostic: if both groups separately avoid robust harm but full T remains worse, record a possible group-interaction or optimization-burden hypothesis without a causal claim

predeclared_diagnostic_availability.Heat pressure-cap decision logits: unavailable from the completed Phase 3 records; logits and a frozen decision scope were not persisted, so no reconstruction is permitted
predeclared_diagnostic_availability.state-action coverage: unavailable as a rate; the completed records do not persist an exact visible state-action denominator
predeclared_diagnostic_availability.unknown-affordance rate: unavailable as a rate; an unknown-alias count exists but the visible-action-slot denominator was not persisted
predeclared_diagnostic_availability.label frequency: not persisted and operationally under-specified; do not derive a post-hoc statistic for selection or claims
predeclared_diagnostic_availability.history length actually available: only aggregate recurrent-step totals are persisted, not the predeclared length distribution; do not invent a histogram
predeclared_diagnostic_availability.shuffle realized-change rate: available only from the typed H4 training and held-out eligible/effective counters with exact lineage; it remains non-selection evidence

execution_boundary.runtime_authority_requirement: before store preparation or execution, bind an authorized post-freeze git commit and immutable protocol/authority bytes plus descriptor identities; reject a symlinked repository or output root and revalidate every byte and identity immediately before execution
